# Initial state: empty book; no balances, authentication, or persistence.
# Defaults: tracked-order limit 10000, per-place event budget 1024.
C 99 1 => ! UnknownOrder
P 1 1 S 100 2 => A 1
C 1 1 => C 1 2
C 1 1 => X 1 Cancelled
P 2 2 S 100 2 => A 2
P 3 3 B 100 2 => A 3 | T 2 3 100 2
C 2 2 => X 2 Filled
S 1 1 Sell 100 2 0 0 2 Cancelled
S 2 2 Sell 100 2 0 2 0 Filled
S 3 3 Buy 100 2 0 2 0 Filled
